waits.words: The crater lake at the centre: ponds and water bodies come with a later Architect release.
The sculpted crater bowl and rim: terrain sculpting brushes are not available yet.
The closed ring street around the lake: ring layouts are not available yet; the houses are laid out on an ordinary street meanwhile.
The rule that every house faces the lake: shape rules can't be verified yet; it is carried in each lot's brief.

answer.summary: A medieval residential town of 16 buildings: 8 lakeside houses, 3 ring cottages, a lake hall tavern, a boathouse with jetty, 2 market shops and a gatehouse. They're built now as one street-laid village, with a lantern-lit street from gate to hall. The crater, lake, closed ring street and the face-the-water rule can't be built yet; they're kept as pending parts and offered when Architect supports them.
